description:
Fast, minimal, monochrome home screen. Type to launch. No ads, no tracking.

MinimalSF is a lightweight black & white home screen built for speed. Start typing and the app you want opens - often before you finish the name.

Type to launch

  • Keyboard is ready as soon as you're home
  • One match opens on its own after a short, adjustable delay
  • Press enter to open the top result; results are ranked by best match
  • Custom keywords per app (e.g. "wa" for WhatsApp) and hide apps from search

Gestures

  • Double tap, long press, and swipe left / right / up / down
  • Open an app, call a contact, run an app shortcut, open a specific app screen, toggle the flashlight, open the camera, control music, lock the screen, open notifications or quick settings
  • Saves "add to home screen" shortcuts from other apps, including Activity Launcher

On the home screen

  • Large clock (tap for alarms) and date
  • Optional screen time for today, with your top apps
  • Optional now playing bar: tap to play/pause, swipe to skip
  • Inline todo list

Make it yours

  • Fonts: monospace, clean, your phone's font, free Google Fonts, or import a .ttf/.otf - plus bold
  • Font and clock size, 12/24h clock, search bar at the top or bottom

Private

  • No internet permission, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
  • Everything is stored on your device

Optional features need permissions you grant yourself: accessibility (only used to lock the screen), notification access (now playing bar) and usage access (screen time). Font downloads use Google Play services when it's installed.
